params.name: team_id
params.description: Scope the listing to a single team. When omitted, returns skills owned by the authenticated user.

params.name: search_query
params.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the skill name.

params.name: sort_order
params.description: Sort order for the returned skills.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Number of skills per page. Clamped between 1 and 100.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned in `next_cursor` from a prior page.

params.name: creator_user_id
params.description: Filter to skills created by this user ID.

params.name: related_server_id
params.description: Filter to skills that reference this MCP server ID in their metadata.

params.name: agent_id
params.description: Filter to skills attached to this agent.

params.name: unused
params.description: When set, filters to skills that have not been used.

items.docs: List skills the caller has access to. Filter by team, search by name, or narrow to a specific creator, related MCP server, or agent.

Upload a skill package and create a new skill. The package must include a `SKILL.md` with `name` and `description` frontmatter; uploads may be a single `.md` file (stored as `SKILL.md`), or a `.zip` / `.skill` archive containing `SKILL.md` at its root. The initial version is created automatically. Maximum upload size is 10 MB.

params.name: skill_id
params.description: ID of the skill to update.

items.docs: Replace a skill's files with a new upload. Reparses `SKILL.md` to update the skill's `name`, `description`, and `metadata`, and creates a new version. Maximum upload size is 10 MB.

params.name: skill_id
params.description: ID of the skill to delete.

items.docs: Permanently delete a skill. This is a soft-delete — the skill will no longer appear in listings or be usable by agents.

params.name: skill_id
params.description: ID of the skill to download.

params.name: version_id
params.description: Specific version to download. When omitted, the current draft is returned.

items.docs: Generate a signed URL to download a skill's contents as a `.skill` archive (ZIP). When `version_id` is provided, returns that exact version; otherwise returns the current draft.
